Class Abilities

1st Level

Spellcasting (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Slot-based casting per the Spellblade Spells Per Day table below, from a narrower Spellblade spell list focused on self-buffs, melee-enhancing effects, and direct-damage spells.
    • Spell DC = 10 + half your Spellblade level (minimum 1) + Intelligence modifier: see Resolving Magic in Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.
    • Harmful or debuffing spells need a save, except Touch spells, which use a touch attack (see Spellcasting in Arneyan).
    • Your cantrips gain their extra dice at your Spellblade level 5, 11 and 17 (see Cantrips in Spellcasting).

Spellstrike

  • Effect: As part of a normal weapon attack with your bonded weapon type, you may deliver a spell through the strike.
  • If the attack hits, the spell's effect triggers on the same target immediately, resolving however that spell normally would (automatic, or a save against your spell DC).
  • No separate action is spent.
  • You may Spellstrike once per round; if the attack misses, the spell is lost and any slot spent on it is expended.
  • Cantrip Spellstrike: at will, no slot cost. Deals 1d4 force damage, or the damage type of an attack cantrip you know, through the strike (2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th).
  • Levelled Spellstrike: from 3rd level, expend a Spellblade spell slot to deliver that spell's full effect through the strike instead. The strike also deals bonus damage of the spell's damage type (force if it has none): +1d6 for a slot of 1st or 2nd level, +2d6 for a slot of 3rd or 4th level.
  • Eligible spells: Spellstrike delivers only a spell that targets a single creature (a touch, a ray or one target at range).
    • Area spells and self-only spells cannot be delivered; a spell that can be split between targets may be delivered if all of it goes to the creature you hit.
    • The target makes any save as normal.
    • On a critical hit, only the weapon's own dice add their maximum (see Critical Hits & Critical Fails in The Arneyan Codex); the spell and the Spellstrike bonus dice are rolled normally.
    • A spell held over by First Cut uses that round's Spellstrike.
  • Casting through the blade: the attack roll is a normal weapon attack against AC.
  • For a Touch spell the weapon hit is the touch: no second roll, and nothing the spell gives its touch attack applies.
  • A Levelled Spellstrike casts that spell: it needs the spell's components (your bonded weapon performs the somatic component and serves as your focus), it can be countered, and Casting Under Threat applies.
  • Spellstrike is your rider for that hit.

Arcane Cascade

  • Effect: After a Spellstrike (cantrip or levelled) that hits, the first attack against you before your next turn has Disadvantage.
  • 9th level: the first two attacks against you before your next turn have Disadvantage

4th Level

War Magic

  • Effect: When you cast a cantrip as your action, you may make one weapon attack with your bonded weapon type straight afterwards. This attack is a plain weapon attack: it can't carry a Spellstrike.

5th Level

Everstrike

  • Effect: Once per encounter, one Levelled Spellstrike of 2nd level or lower costs no slot.
  • 15th level: of 4th level or lower

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional attack with your bonded weapon type as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Spellstrike may be delivered through either attack.
  • Spellstrike still rides only one attack a round.

10th Level

Spell Surge

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher as your action, you also make one weapon attack with your bonded weapon type as part of that action.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Blade-mage. Fighting schools and mage colleges both let you train with them free, and weapon training takes half as long. Your first follower, a student, joins you.

13th Level

Spell Sight

  • Effect: Touch an object, door or person with your bonded weapon for a minute, and you learn whether it carries magic, a ward or a curse, and the school and rough strength of each.

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a training hall as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Everstrike improves, as its entry says.

17th Level

Arcane Smith

  • Effect: In downtime you enchant weapons and armour in half the time and at half the cost. You still need the spells.

20th Level

Twinned Strike

  • Effect: Once per encounter, one Levelled Spellstrike delivers two different prepared spells through the same hit.
  • Spend a slot for each.
  • The target saves against each on its own, and Spellstrike's bonus dice are added once, for the higher slot.
  • On a miss both are lost.

Renown: Order of the Blade

  • Effect: Your stronghold becomes your school of spellblades (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 students (1st-level Spellblades) join it. While you hold it, you may change your bonded weapon type during a rest.

Feats of Arneyan

  • The Spellblade may choose from either the Martial Path or the Arcane & Devout Path at any Feat level without needing to multiclass. A Spellblade with the Shadow Edge kit may also choose from the Specialist Path.

Kits: Spellblade Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Spellblade folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation.

  • All share the Spellstrike and Arcane Cascade baseline above.
  • Each kit reshapes one of your 1st-level features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

Spellblade Spells Per Day

  • Slots are as in the table below, up to the maximum spell level of 4th.
  • A Spellblade has no spell slots at 1st and 2nd level, only cantrips and Cantrip Spellstrike; the 1st-level spells in your starting spellbook may be prepared from 3rd level.
  • Cantrips are cast at will.
  • Bonus spells from high Intelligence apply once the Spellblade is high enough level to cast that tier.

Spellblade Spell List

Spells available to the Spellblade, by level. * = reversible spell.

  • Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.
  • Includes every Wizard-list spell of the Spellblade’s favoured schools (Evocation and Abjuration), up to the highest spell level the Spellblade can cast, except Stoneskin and Melf's Minute Meteors.
